R5D-duck-backcountry-0001.name: Unnamed wetland by Big Creek
R5D-duck-backcountry-0001.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).

evidence.t: About 55 wetlands within 2 km (estimate): ducks move between them.
Beside Big Creek: backwater or oxbow (estimate).

flags.t: MU (Management Unit) 5-3, Region 5 Cariboo. Near the MU line: check the MU map.
Spot is inside an ATV (all terrain vehicle) for Hunting Closed Area: South Chilcotin and M.U. 5-14. Closed between 4:00 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. from September 1 to November 30. Synopsis map 4-2/23.
Route crosses provincial park: Big Creek Park. Hunting only where that park allows it, in open season. Check its bcparks.ca page (synopsis page 9, 99%).

seasonRows.notes: District 5. Within the 8 a day: 4 northern pintails, 4 canvasbacks, 2 Barrow's or common goldeneyes together, 2 harlequins. Possession 24: 12, 12, 6, 6.

plan: Drive: from Soda Creek, about 148 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Soda Creek Townsite Rd, Williams Lake Cut-Off Rd, Buckskin Rd, West Fraser Rd.
Park: 51.41798, -122.97204, pull off on A20019-X53-8 (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 5.6 km SW, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 80 m, about 120 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 90 m NE of the spot at 1,547 m (51.37606, -123.01415). Water: unnamed wetland 60 m NW (estimate).
Hunt: ducks, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 5-3, Region 5. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-07, closures 2026-10-16.
R5D-duck-backcountry-0001.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 5-3: about 8,065 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 2.20 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
